name: Hard Voxelization with Capacity Limits
definition: Inserts 3D points into a voxel grid, enforcing a maximum points-per-voxel limit, marking chunks as modified, and handling out-of-window or invalid points.
summary: Hard Voxelization with Capacity Limits inserts 3D points into a sparse voxel grid while enforcing a strict maximum points-per-voxel limit, rejecting excess points rather than aggregating or averaging them.
